title: RepID Fact
description: A structured RepID fact reconstructed from a Bitcoin Cash transaction. Exactly one of the eight protocol fact types. Field names and types are normative (SPEC-008 section 3).

pkh.description: 20-byte public key hash, lowercase hex, display order.

txid.description: 32-byte transaction identifier, lowercase hex, display order.

outpoint.description: A transaction identifier and output index, `txid:vout`.

satoshis.description: An amount in satoshis, as a decimal string. A string, never a JSON number: BCH amounts exceed the IEEE-754 safe integer range.

byteHex.description: A single byte as lowercase hex.

ownerPkh.description: Holder of the Rating Right: the party entitled to rate.

ratesPkh.description: Counterparty: the party this right entitles its holder to rate.

oneOf.title: E1 IDENTITY_GENESIS
oneOf.description: An identity was minted. Two forms: vault (with collateral) and legacy (P2PKH, no collateral). SPEC-001.

ownerPkh.description: Owner of the identity. In vault form this is also the NFT commitment.

collateral.description: Required in vault form, absent in legacy form. The value of the covenant output.

identityOutpoint.description: Required in vault form. The covenant outpoint that the vault is tracked at, so later spends can be recognized as top-up or burn.

oneOf.title: E2 IDENTITY_COLLATERAL_TOP_UP
oneOf.description: An identity's collateral was increased. The covenant never lets it decrease on-chain, so a decrease is recognized and reported as invalid. SPEC-001.

spentOutpoint.description: The vault outpoint that was spent.

oneOf.title: E3 IDENTITY_BURNED
oneOf.description: An identity was burned. The collateral returns to the owner and the identity loses validity. SPEC-001.

oneOf.title: E4 RECEIPT_GENESIS
oneOf.description: A Receipt and its two Rating Rights were minted in the same transaction. The only event that creates Rating Rights. SPEC-003.

ratingRights.description: Exactly two: one per party, cross-referencing each other.

receiptContext.description: Optional interaction context decoded from the Receipt's NFT commitment (SPEC-009 §9.2). Absent when the commitment is empty (legacy form).

roleA.description: Role declared for the receipt owner (receiptOwnerPkh).

roleB.description: Role declared for the other party, the partner of the receipt owner.

oneOf.title: E5 RATING_ISSUED
oneOf.description: A rating was issued by spending a Rating Right. The right is single use: the covenant's only path destroys the NFT on spend, which is what enforces one rating per participant at the chain level (SPEC-008 RF-S01). SPEC-004.

spentOutpoint.description: The Rating Right that was spent.

score.description: The encoded single byte. It is NOT constrained to 1-5 here: an out-of-range value must still be reported with valid=false, never dropped or clamped (SPEC-009 RF-W08).

commentHash.description: Present only when the Rating Right was spent with REPID_RATING2 (SPEC-009 §4.2); absent with REPID_RATING1.

score.description: A valid rating is necessarily within MIN_SCORE..MAX_SCORE. The type is restated here because this subschema is evaluated on its own; it is redundant with the enclosing score definition and does not change which facts are accepted.

oneOf.title: E6 PLATFORM_CONFIRMATION
oneOf.description: A validating entity corroborated an interaction. Valid only if the referenced Receipt is already indexed, which makes this fact order dependent (SPEC-003, SPEC-005 section 5).

platformPkh.description: Resolved from the unlocking script of the first input: the confirmator is the entity spending its own UTXO.

oneOf.title: E7 TRUST_LINK
oneOf.description: A declared trust from A to B, unilateral: no consent from B, no Rating Rights, no prior identity. Self-trust is invalid. Addresses cold start. SPEC-006.

oneOf.title: E8 RATING_RETRACTION
oneOf.description: A rater unilaterally retracted a rating it had issued, referencing the rating's Receipt txid (REPID_RETRACT1). The original RATING_ISSUED is never deleted; the chain records, it does not rescind. SPEC-004 RF-06/RF-07.

raterPkh.description: The rater who issued the original rating and now retracts it.

receiptTxid.description: The Receipt whose rating is being retracted, in display order as referenced by REPID_RETRACT1.

$comment: Two rules are normative but NOT expressible in JSON Schema, and are therefore enforced by implementations and conformance tests rather than here: (1) trusterPkh != trustedPkh for a valid TRUST_LINK (SPEC-006 RF-04) - JSON Schema cannot compare two sibling property values; (2) collateral >= previousCollateral for a valid IDENTITY_COLLATERAL_TOP_UP (SPEC-001) - same reason. New in 0.4.0: (3) a valid RATING_RETRACTION requires the referenced rating to exist, to be signed by raterPkh, and to be the first retraction of that rating (SPEC-004 RF-07) - depends on retained state, not statically expressible; (4) a valid PLATFORM_CONFIRMATION requires the confirmer to be neither partyA nor partyB of the referenced Receipt (SPEC-003 RF-10) - depends on the Receipt index; (5) commentHash and contextHash fidelity (a different comment or context with the same hash) is not expressible and stays off-chain (SPEC-004 RF-09).
